PowerlinkNMTStateEnumeration.description: This DataType is an enumeration that represents the NMT State

NMT_GS_INITIALISING.description: first state after power-on of the POWERLINK Device

NMT_GS_RESET_APPLICATION.description: set manufacturer-specific and standardised device profile area to their power-on values

NMT_GS_RESET_COMMUNICATION.description: set communication profile area (except ERR_History_ADOM) to their power-on values

NMT_XS_NOT_ACTIVE.description: a non-permanent state which allows a starting device to recognize the current network state

NMT_XS_PRE_OPERATIONAL_1.description: the POWERLINK network operates in reduced cycle

NMT_XS_PRE_OPERATIONAL_2.description: the POWERLINK network operates in isochronous operation, but the device is still in a configuration state

NMT_XS_READY_TO_OPERATE.description: the device configuration is completed and the device is ready to switch over to NMT_XS_OPERATIONAL

NMT_XS_OPERATIONAL.description: normal operating state of a POWERLINK Device

NMT_CS_STOPPED.description: the device is largely passive, NMT_CS_STOPPED shall be used for controlled shutdown of a selected CN while the system is still running

NMT_XS_BASIC_ETHERNET.description: Legacy Ethernet communication according to IEEE 802.3, no POWERLINK specific network traffic control
